$description: ComponentLab V2 token vocabulary. Only names registered here (or valid enum steps per group) may enter the canonical source. The compiler rejects unregistered words in enumerated positions. This file is the naming authority; it deliberately has no synonyms for the same concept.

primitive.duty: Raw color values, scales, fonts, weights. No component state intent.

reference.$description: The reference palette family carries the approved L-indexed p-* steps. p-87/p-93/p-96/p-98 are light-background steps; the family is kept separate from the reverse-indexed gray/purple scales so values never collide by name.

profile.duty: Environment-dependent sizes, typography scale, grid mapping. Never mixes Light/Dark or component states.

default.step: indexed scale step or registered variant

semantic.duty: Shared usage intent: surfaces, text, icons, borders, actions, status. Must not depend on private component paths.

projectRoles.heading: title-like display role carried from the audited design
projectRoles.subtitle: secondary title role
projectRoles.content: reserved for actual content containers, never a text style

sharedGroups.$description: Shared scales that are intentionally not copied into every role variant.
sharedGroups.font-weight: shared scale; role variants reference it when a weight is role-specific

size.role: reference-defined content/icon height and padding scale (fixed 16..56 heights, 2..12 paddings); distinct from interaction-size (profile-scaled interactive control heights)

layout.role: layout spacing roles: margin / padding / grid

asset.role: asset reference registry; values are asset identifiers, not copy text

component.duty: Registered component parts, states, sizes and private style decisions.

rowStatus.$description: Table row status axis from the reference files; states combine row status with interaction (e.g. alarm-hover).

propertyVocabulary.$description: Fixed property vocabulary; border_width/borderWidth/bw are mapped to border-width only when identified as the same concept.
propertyVocabulary.background: kept only for true multi-layer backgrounds; a plain color background must use background-color

gradient.$description: Gradient stops are registered slots; position, direction, geometry and interpolation are component drawing contracts, not per-state hand-maintained scattered colors.

product.duty: Product configuration / override packages inside the same publishing system, never a fifth base layer.

axes.name: profile
axes.description: Design profile modes from the audited 02.profile collection.

axes.name: theme
axes.description: Color-scheme modes from the audited 03.semantic collection.

runtimeLegacyAxes.$description: Legacy Qt runtime axis names are consumers, not design modes. comfortable/compact density is NOT equivalent to standard/wide profile.
runtimeLegacyAxes.densityPolicy: Separately recorded; no V2 token carries a density mode.

opacityPolicy.rule: Computation always converts the declared source unit to 0..1; percent values are never silently read as ratios.

colorPolicy.none: color/none means no paint; expressed through component drawing contracts, never converted to white
